Add back the SAME white ruffled headband from image 2 on top of the blue hair in each of the twelve poses of image 1. Keep its size, curve and position matching the corresponding pose in image 2.
Everything else in image 1 stays unchanged: exact face and head scale, hair and ahoge silhouette, fin ears, bow and tail, white/navy short-sleeve shirt, above-knee navy shorts, socks and sneakers, anatomy and body proportions, all twelve hand and leg poses and all sole locations. Transparent alpha background. No new background, glow, props, labels or text. Only restore the white headband.
